subject: 英语
description: 六年级上册英语考点笔记总结

cards.title: 人物描述与职业表达
cards.definition: 学会用英语描述人物的外貌、性格特征，并表达不同职业。
core_points: 描述外貌：使用`be`动词（如`tall/short`, `fat/thin`）或`have/has`（如`long hair`, `big eyes`）。
描述性格：使用`be`动词加形容词（如`kind`, `funny`, `strict`, `smart`）。
常见职业词汇：`teacher`, `doctor`, `driver`, `cook`, `farmer`等，注意单数职业前加`a/an`。
提问职业：`What do you do?` / `What does he/she do?`
提问人物特征：`What does he/she look like?` (外貌) / `What is he/she like?` (性格)

example.question: 根据图片和提示词，描述你的新老师：(Ms. Gao, tall, kind, a good teacher)
steps: 1. 介绍老师名字：She is Ms. Gao.
4. 描述职业：She is a good teacher.
example.answer: She is Ms. Gao. She is tall. She is kind. She is a good teacher.

mistakes.wrong: He is a teacher. He is a tall.
mistakes.correct: He is a teacher. He is tall. (形容词前不加a/an)

mistakes.wrong: She have long hair.
mistakes.correct: She has long hair. (主谓一致：第三人称单数用has)

cards.memory_tip: 『高矮胖瘦』用be，『有无头发』用have/has。职业前面『a/an』，『三单』『be』要分清。

related.prerequisite: 人称代词、be动词、have/has动词用法
related.next: 一般现在时描述日常活动

exam_focus.scoring_key: 主谓一致，形容词和名词的正确使用，大小写和标点。
exam_focus.common_trap: 形容词前误加a/an；have/has与主语不一致；职业词汇拼写错误。

real_exam_example.question: My father is a ______. He works in a hospital. (A. driver B. doctor C. farmer)
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 根据上下文语境（works in a hospital）判断职业。

cards.title: 季节、天气与活动
cards.definition: 掌握四季名称、天气描述词汇，并能用一般现在时描述季节性活动。
core_points: 四季名称：`spring`, `summer`, `autumn` (或`fall`), `winter`。
天气词汇：`sunny`, `rainy`, `cloudy`, `windy`, `snowy`, `hot`, `cold`, `warm`, `cool`。
天气提问：`What's the weather like in...?` 或 `How's the weather in...?`
季节性活动：`plant trees`, `swim`, `go hiking`, `make a snowman`, `fly kites`等。
描述活动：使用一般现在时，注意第三人称单数动词加`s/es`。

example.question: 描述冬天（Winter）的天气和人们常做的活动。
steps: 2. 描述天气：It's cold and snowy.
3. 描述活动：People often make a snowman and go skating.
example.answer: It's winter. It's cold and snowy. People often make a snowman and go skating.

mistakes.wrong: In summer, I swimming.
mistakes.correct: In summer, I swim. (一般现在时动词原形)

mistakes.wrong: The weather is wind.
mistakes.correct: The weather is windy. (形容词修饰)

cards.memory_tip: 『四季』分清，『天气』加y。『活动』动词用原形，『三单』别忘加s。

exam_focus.scoring_key: 词汇拼写准确，主谓一致，形容词与名词的正确使用。
exam_focus.common_trap: 天气名词与形容词混淆；描述活动时动词形式错误。

real_exam_example.question: What's the weather like in winter? It's ______ and snowy. (A. hot B. warm C. cold)
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 根据季节特点选择合适的天气词汇。

cards.title: 一般将来时 (be going to)
cards.definition: 掌握一般将来时`be going to + 动词原形`的用法，表示即将发生的计划或打算。
core_points: 构成：主语 + `be`动词 (am/is/are) + `going to` + 动词原形。
用法：表示有计划、有准备的将要发生的动作或意图。
时间状语：`tomorrow`, `next week/month/year`, `this weekend`, `tonight`等。
肯定句：`I am going to play football.`
否定句：`I am not going to play football.` (`be`动词后加`not`)
疑问句：`Are you going to play football?` (`be`动词提前)

example.question: 根据提示词，用`be going to`造句：(I / visit my grandparents / this Sunday)
steps: 4. 加上宾语和时间状语`my grandparents this Sunday`。
example.answer: I am going to visit my grandparents this Sunday.

mistakes.wrong: He is going to plays basketball.
mistakes.correct: He is going to play basketball. (going to 后接动词原形)

mistakes.wrong: Are you going to go to the park?
mistakes.correct: Are you going to the park? (go to the park 表示去公园，go to go to the park 语感重复)

cards.memory_tip: 『be going to』『动原』跟着走，计划打算全都有。

related.prerequisite: be动词用法，动词原形概念

exam_focus.scoring_key: be动词与主语一致，going to 后接动词原形，否定句和疑问句形式正确。
exam_focus.common_trap: 忘记be动词或be动词形式错误；going to 后动词加s或ing。

real_exam_example.question: What ______ you going to do this weekend? (A. is B. am C. are)

cards.title: 一般将来时 (will)
cards.definition: 掌握一般将来时`will + 动词原形`的用法，表示将来会发生的事情或主观意愿。
core_points: 构成：主语 + `will` + 动词原形。
用法：表示将来会发生的事情（常用于预测），或主观意愿、临时的决定。
时间状语：`tomorrow`, `next week/month/year`, `tonight`等。
肯定句：`I will go to the park.` 缩写：`I'll go to the park.`
否定句：`I will not go to the park.` 缩写：`I won't go to the park.` (`will`后加`not`)
疑问句：`Will you go to the park?` (`will`提前)

example.question: 根据提示词，用`will`造句：(He / watch TV / tonight)
steps: 4. 加上宾语和时间状语`TV tonight`。

mistakes.wrong: She will goes to school tomorrow.
mistakes.correct: She will go to school tomorrow. (will 后接动词原形)

mistakes.wrong: Will he not come?
mistakes.correct: Will he come? (否定疑问句通常用Won't he come? 或在陈述句后加问号变为疑问)

cards.memory_tip: 『will』很『will』，后面『动原』真自由。预测打算都可用，否定『won't』不发愁。

related.prerequisite: be动词用法，动词原形概念

exam_focus.scoring_key: will 后接动词原形，否定句和疑问句形式正确。
exam_focus.common_trap: will 后动词加s或ing；will not 缩写成won't 拼写错误。

real_exam_example.question: I think it ______ be sunny tomorrow. (A. is B. will C. going to)
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 表示对未来天气的预测，用`will`更自然，且`going to`缺少`be`动词。

units.unit_name: Unit 4 I Have a Pen Pal

cards.title: 日常活动与时间表达
cards.definition: 掌握描述日常活动的词汇和短语，并学会用介词`at/in/on`表达时间。
core_points: 日常活动词汇：`get up`, `eat breakfast/lunch/dinner`, `go to school`, `do homework`, `read books`, `watch TV`, `go to bed`等。
时间表达介词：`at` + 具体时间点（`at 6 o'clock`, `at noon`）；`in` + 年/月/季节/上午/下午/晚上（`in 2023`, `in July`, `in spring`, `in the morning/afternoon/evening`）；`on` + 具体日期/星期几（`on Monday`, `on May 1st`）。
提问时间：`What time do you...?` / `When do you...?`
描述活动：通常使用一般现在时。

example.question: 用英语描述你早上7点吃早饭。
steps: 3. 确定时间`7 o'clock`，搭配介词`at`。
example.answer: I eat breakfast at 7 o'clock in the morning.

mistakes.wrong: I go to school in 7 o'clock.
mistakes.correct: I go to school at 7 o'clock. (具体时间点用at)

mistakes.wrong: He watch TV in the evening.
mistakes.correct: He watches TV in the evening. (第三人称单数动词加es)

cards.memory_tip: 『at』点钟，『in』早中晚、年月季。『on』周几、日期不混淆，日常动词三单别忘s。

related.prerequisite: 一般现在时，介词in/on/at基础用法
related.next: 一般过去时描述过去活动

exam_focus.scoring_key: 介词使用正确，动词形式正确，日常活动词汇拼写无误。
exam_focus.common_trap: 介词in/on/at混淆；第三人称单数动词忘记加s/es。

real_exam_example.question: We usually have lunch ______ noon. (A. in B. on C. at)

units.unit_name: Unit 5 A Trip to the Zoo

cards.title: 一般过去时 (be动词)
cards.definition: 掌握be动词在一般过去时中的形式和用法，描述过去的状态或事实。
core_points: be动词过去式：`am/is`的过去式是`was`；`are`的过去式是`were`。
用法：表示过去某一时间点发生的事情或存在的情况。
时间状语：`yesterday`, `last night/week/month/year`, `two days ago`, `in 2022`等。
肯定句：`I was happy yesterday.` / `They were at the zoo last Sunday.`
否定句：`I was not happy.` (wasn't) / `They were not at the zoo.` (weren't)
疑问句：`Was he happy?` / `Were they at the zoo?` (was/were提前)

example.question: 用一般过去时改写句子：(She is a student now. → Yesterday, she ____ a student.)
steps: 2. 确定主语`she`是第三人称单数。

mistakes.wrong: We was at home last night.
mistakes.correct: We were at home last night. (主语`We`是复数，用`were`)

mistakes.wrong: Were you not happy?
mistakes.correct: Were you happy? (或 Were you not happy? / Weren't you happy? 但小学阶段避免否定疑问句)

cards.memory_tip: 『我单他她它』用was，『你我他们』用were。过去时间很明确，be动词变身不纠结。

exam_focus.scoring_key: was/were与主语一致，否定句和疑问句形式正确，时间状语与时态匹配。
exam_focus.common_trap: was/were与主语不一致；时间状语判断错误导致时态混淆。

real_exam_example.question: My father ______ a teacher ten years ago. Now he is a doctor. (A. is B. was C. were)
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: `ten years ago`是过去时间，且`father`是单数，选`was`。

cards.title: 一般过去时 (规则动词)
cards.definition: 掌握规则动词过去式的构成和用法，描述过去发生的动作。
core_points: 构成：动词原形后加`-ed` (如`played`, `watched`)。
特殊变化：
1. 以`e`结尾的动词加`-d` (如`lived`, `liked`)。
2. 以`辅音字母+y`结尾的动词，变`y`为`i`再加`-ed` (如`studied`, `cried`)。
3. 重读闭音节，末尾只有一个辅音字母，双写该辅音字母再加`-ed` (如`stopped`, `planned`)。
否定句：`didn't + 动词原形` (如`I didn't play football.`)
疑问句：`Did + 主语 + 动词原形...?` (如`Did you play football?`)

example.question: 用一般过去时改写句子：(They often watch TV. → Yesterday, they ____ TV.)

mistakes.wrong: He played football yesterday. He didn't played basketball.
mistakes.correct: He played football yesterday. He didn't play basketball. (didn't 后接动词原形)

mistakes.wrong: Did she studies English?
mistakes.correct: Did she study English? (Did 疑问句中动词用原形)

cards.memory_tip: 『规则动词』加ed，特殊变化要牢记。否定疑问『did』来帮，动词原形跑不了。

related.prerequisite: 动词原形概念，一般现在时
related.next: 一般过去时 (不规则动词)

exam_focus.scoring_key: 规则动词过去式变化正确，否定句和疑问句中使用动词原形。
exam_focus.common_trap: 动词过去式拼写错误；否定句和疑问句中动词忘记还原为原形。

real_exam_example.question: My mother ______ (clean) the room last Sunday.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: `last Sunday`是过去时间，`clean`是规则动词，加`-ed`。

units.unit_name: Unit 6 How Do You Go There?

cards.title: 一般过去时 (不规则动词)
cards.definition: 掌握常见不规则动词的过去式形式和用法，描述过去发生的动作。
core_points: 构成：不规则动词的过去式没有规律，需要单独记忆 (如`go-went`, `eat-ate`, `see-saw`, `have-had`, `do-did`, `say-said`, `buy-bought`, `take-took`, `come-came`)。
用法：与规则动词相同，表示过去某一时间点发生的动作。
否定句：`didn't + 动词原形` (如`I didn't go to school yesterday.`)
疑问句：`Did + 主语 + 动词原形...?` (如`Did you eat breakfast?`)

example.question: 用一般过去时改写句子：(She goes to the park every day. → She ____ to the park yesterday.)
steps: 1. 识别原句动词`goes`，其原形是`go`。
example.answer: She went to the park yesterday.

mistakes.wrong: I eated an apple.
mistakes.correct: I ate an apple. (`eat`是不规则动词，过去式是`ate`)

mistakes.wrong: Did you went to the cinema?
mistakes.correct: Did you go to the cinema? (Did 疑问句中动词用原形)

cards.memory_tip: 『不规则』动词不讲理，背诵记忆是王道。否定疑问『did』来帮，动词原形不能忘。

related.prerequisite: 动词原形概念，规则动词过去式

exam_focus.scoring_key: 不规则动词过去式形式正确，否定句和疑问句中使用动词原形。
exam_focus.common_trap: 不规则动词误当规则动词处理；否定句和疑问句中动词忘记还原为原形。

real_exam_example.question: Last night, I ______ (have) a good dream.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: `last night`是过去时间，`have`是不规则动词，过去式是`had`。

cards.title: 交通方式与问路指路
cards.definition: 掌握常见交通方式的表达，以及问路和指路的基本句型。
core_points: 交通方式：`by bus`, `by car`, `by bike`, `by train`, `by plane`, `by subway`。步行用`on foot`。
提问交通方式：`How do you go to...?`
问路：`Excuse me, where is...?` / `How can I get to...?`
指路：`Go straight.`, `Turn left/right.`, `It's on your left/right.`, `It's next to/between...`。
介词应用：`go to school by bus` (乘坐交通工具)；`walk to school on foot` (步行)。

example.question: 用英语描述你乘公交车去学校。
steps: 2. 确定动词短语`go to school`。
3. 确定交通方式`bus`，搭配介词`by`。
example.answer: I go to school by bus.

mistakes.wrong: He goes to school by a car.
mistakes.correct: He goes to school by car. (by后接交通工具名词时通常不加a/an)

mistakes.wrong: Go straightly.
mistakes.correct: Go straight. (straight在此作副词，直接修饰go)

cards.memory_tip: 『by』交通工具不加『a』，『on foot』步行要记牢。问路『where/how』，指路『直左右』。

exam_focus.scoring_key: 介词`by`和`on`的正确使用，交通方式词汇拼写，问路指路句型完整。
exam_focus.common_trap: by后多加a/an；on foot拼写或使用错误；指路方向混淆。

real_exam_example.question: A: How do you go to the library? B: I go there ______. (A. by foot B. on foot C. by bus)
real_exam_example.answer: C. by bus (或B. on foot，如果选项中没有by bus)
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 考察交通方式介词的正确使用。

cards.title: 阅读理解策略
cards.definition: 掌握阅读理解的基本方法和技巧，提高获取信息和推断的能力。
core_points: 通读全文：快速浏览文章，了解大意和主旨。
细读问题：仔细阅读题目，划出关键词，明确考查点。
定位信息：根据问题关键词，回文章中查找相关句子或段落。
理解句意：结合上下文理解生词、难句，不要逐字翻译。
逻辑推断：对于没有直接答案的问题，根据文章信息进行合理推断。
核对答案：选择或写出答案后，再次与文章和问题核对，确保无误。

example.question:
阅读短文，判断正误：
My name is Mike. I am 12. I like playing football. Last Sunday, I went to the park with my father. We played football there. We were very happy.
(1) Mike is 10 years old. (T/F)
(2) Mike played football with his mother last Sunday. (T/F)
steps: 1. 读问题(1)：关键词`Mike is 10 years old`。
4. 读问题(2)：关键词`played football with his mother`。
5. 定位原文：`I went to the park with my father. We played football there.`

mistakes.wrong: 只看题目中的关键词，不结合原文语境理解。
mistakes.correct: 关键词定位后，需仔细阅读关键词所在句子的前后文，确保理解准确。

mistakes.wrong: 遇到生词就卡壳，无法继续阅读。
mistakes.correct: 尝试根据上下文猜测生词含义，或跳过不影响主旨的生词。

cards.memory_tip: 『通读』抓大意，『细读』找问题。『定位』关键词，『推断』莫着急。核对仔细，高分有戏。

related.prerequisite: 大量词汇积累，基本语法知识

exam_focus.scoring_key: 理解文章主旨和细节，准确捕捉信息，合理推断。
exam_focus.common_trap: 信息定位不准；对细节理解有偏差；过度推断或脑补。

real_exam_example.question: （短文略）What did Sam do yesterday? (A. He went swimming. B. He cleaned his room. C. He played computer games.)
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 根据文中`yesterday`后Sam的具体行为来选择，排除干扰项。

cards.title: 书面表达 (介绍类)
cards.definition: 掌握写作介绍类短文（如介绍自己、家人、朋友、一天）的基本结构和常用句型。
core_points: 开篇：点明主题，简单介绍（`My name is...`, `I am...`, `This is my friend...`）。
主体：
1. 介绍人物：外貌、性格、爱好、职业、喜欢做的事（用一般现在时）。
2. 介绍一天：按照时间顺序描述活动（用一般现在时，注意时间介词）。
3. 介绍地点：地理位置、有什么、能做什么（用`there be`句型，一般现在时）。
结尾：简短总结或表达感受（`I love my family.`, `I have a happy day.`）。
常用连接词：`and`, `but`, `then`, `also`。
写作注意：时态一致，主谓一致，大小写和标点符号正确。

example.question: 以『My Best Friend』为题，写一篇50词左右的短文。
steps: 1. 确定介绍对象：My best friend, Lily。
2. 介绍基本信息：She is 11. She is tall and has long hair。
3. 介绍性格爱好：She is kind and funny. She likes reading and drawing. She often plays with me.
4. 总结：I like her very much.
example.answer:
My Best Friend
I have a best friend. Her name is Lily. She is 11 years old. She is tall and has long hair. She is kind and funny. Lily likes reading and drawing. She often plays with me after school. We are good friends. I like her very much.

mistakes.wrong: 时态混乱，一会儿现在时一会儿过去时。
mistakes.correct: 介绍类文章通常使用一般现在时，除非明确描述过去发生的事情。

mistakes.wrong: 句子结构单一，都是主谓宾。
mistakes.correct: 尝试使用一些连接词，或在句首使用时间状语，使文章更流畅。

cards.memory_tip: 『开篇』点题，『主体』详说。『时间顺序』排活动，『外貌性格』细描摹。『结尾』总结，『标点』不漏。

related.prerequisite: 词汇、句型、语法知识的综合运用

exam_focus.scoring_key: 内容切题，条理清晰，语法正确，句型多样，词汇准确，书写规范。
exam_focus.common_trap: 拼写错误，标点符号错误，时态语态错误，主谓不一致，大小写不规范。

real_exam_example.question: 请以`My Happy Weekend`为题，写一篇短文，描述你上个周末做了什么。不少于5句话。
real_exam_example.answer: Last weekend was great. I went to the park with my family. We played games and had a picnic. On Sunday, I did my homework and read a book. I was very happy.
real_exam_example.scoring_notes: 考察一般过去时运用，内容连贯，句型完整，词汇拼写。
